What we do我們做什麼

You focus on your business and your life. We'll think the money through with you.你專心經營事業和生活，財富的事，有我們一起想清楚。

From Singapore, we work with private banks in Switzerland and Singapore and with cross-border brokers to give high-net-worth families and business owners wealth management in one place: protecting your wealth, enriching your life, and passing it on well.我們以新加坡為基地，與瑞士和新加坡的私人銀行、跨境券商合作，為高資產家庭與企業主提供一站式的財富管理：守住財富，豐富生活，完整傳承。

How we work合作方式

Five stages, each with an end.五個階段，每一個都有終點。

You know what each stage produces before it begins, and you can stop after any of them.每個階段開始前，你就知道會拿到什麼；任何一個階段結束後，你都可以停下來。

STAGE 0

Discovery初談

60 minutes · Free60 分鐘・免費

Understand your questions and confirm we are a good fit.了解你的問題，確認彼此適合。

STAGE 1

Wealth check-up財富健檢

One-time一次性

Six deliverables, plus a 90-minute review.六項產出，加 90 分鐘檢視會談。

STAGE 2

Comprehensive plan全面規劃

One-time一次性

A written plan and action checklist, with a follow-up after 90 days.書面規劃書與執行清單，90 天後追蹤一次。

STAGE 3

Ongoing advisory持續顧問

Quarterly按季

Quarterly reviews, an annual plan update, unlimited questions.每季檢視、年度更新、問題不限次數。

STAGE 4

Asset management資產管理

Ongoing持續

Ongoing management of your portfolio and cross-border accounts.投資組合與跨境帳戶的持續管理。

Stage 3 begins once Stage 2 is complete.第三階段需先完成第二階段。

About關於

Fresco Su蘇佑成 Fresco Su

For twenty years I ran commercial businesses across Asia-Pacific, leading teams through market entries, restructurings, social unrest and a pandemic. That career taught me how money behaves under pressure, and how differently people decide when the money is their own. Since 2025 I have turned to what I care about most: helping like-minded people plan their finances so they can get on with living their lives.過去二十年，我在亞太市場經營商業業務，帶著團隊走過市場開拓、組織重整、社會動盪與一場疫情。那段職涯讓我看清錢在壓力下的樣子，也看清當賭注是自己的時候，人的判斷會有多不同。2025 年起，我轉向自己真正熱愛的事：陪伴理念相近的人把財務安排好，然後好好過生活。
